verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs repeatedly describe continuous monitoring of connected systems with alerts and live dashboards (docs-3, docs-39, docs-22). Dedicated pages for Monitor Access Checks and Continuous Risk Monitoring, plus integration-level checks such as offboarding verification (docs-67), show automated control checks running against integrated systems rather than at audit time. missing for 10: documented test cadence or alerting latency proving failures surface 'within hours', detailed docs on how automated control tests and failure alerts work, independent or hands-on corroboration.
